answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 31589 Country: Pakistan Title: If some one give gold to other as loan on the terms that when the other return he will return the same quantity of gold, Is this deal is permissibl? Question: If some one give gold to other as loan on the terms that when the other return he will return the same quantity of gold, Is this deal is permissibl? Answer ID: 31589 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 840/840/M=1432) The said condition is alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
